name: squidlor
description: Live crypto and tokenized-stock prices from the Squidlor oracle network, plus wallet balances and unsigned token transfers for the user to sign. Prices are the on-chain median across Chainlink, Pyth, RedStone, DIA, Supra and more, with per-provider comparison, history, OHLC and an audit trail.

interface.longDescription: Ask Codex for the price of BTC, ETH, NVDA or any Squidlor feed and get the aggregated on-chain median with the provider breakdown behind it: what Chainlink, Pyth, RedStone and the rest each reported, how stale each print is, and whether they agree. Pull history, OHLC candles and the audit trail of flagged deviations. Look up a wallet's balances across EVM chains and prepare a token transfer: Squidlor resolves the token from what the wallet holds, checks the balance, and returns an unsigned transaction. Nothing in this plugin can sign or move funds; the user signs with their own wallet.
defaultPrompt: What is BTC trading at right now, and do the oracle providers agree?
Show ETH/USD 1h candles for the last day
Prepare a transfer of 25 USDC on Arbitrum from 0x... to 0x...
